## Checks (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Everything is in my own words. No copied passages from books, ads or courses, and no per-book notes.
- [ ] No invented facts, statistics, testimonials or customers. Unknowns are marked `UNKNOWN`.
- [ ] Factual claims and rules have a source and a date.
- [ ] Any case material is real, anonymised and shared with permission (or labelled as a composite).
- [ ] No confidential or personal data.
- [ ] If I added a file, I also added it to the table in `SKILL.md` and to `knowledge/README.md`.
- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter is still valid and the paths I mention exist.
- [ ] I ran the skill on at least two briefs before and after, and pasted the relevant output below (if this changes behaviour).
- [ ] I agree my contribution is released under the MIT licence.

## AI assistance
- [ ] No AI was used
- [ ] AI helped draft this, and I checked every fact and source myself
